title: NPE in configureFeatures with bazel 3.0.0 and 3.1.0rc1
body:
### Description of the problem / feature request:

NPE in configureFeatures in aspect-based build with bazel 3.0.0 and 3.1.0rc1.

### Feature requests: what underlyng problem are you trying to solve with this feature?

I would like for bazel to not fail due to an NPE.

### Bugs: what's the simplest, easiest way to reproduce this bug? Please provide a minimal example if possible.

Our build system is somewhat large and it will take me some time to come up with a small reproducer. So far, the problem has shown up in two out of two attempts to do this particular build.  Pending a small reproducer, I will be happy to try out speculative fixes if you like.

### What operating system are you running Bazel on?

Ubuntu 18.04

### What's the output of `bazel info release`?

release 3.0.0
release 3.1.0rc1

###  Have you found anything relevant by searching the web?

An NPE in bazel is always a bug, so I didn't look elsewhere.

### Any other information, logs, or outputs that you want to share?
